description: This file is a test script for Git's merge abort functionality, setting up a repository with various branch conflicts and testing the behavior of 'git merge --abort' under different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with setup commands within its string argument.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is expected to fail; verifies failure.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks that a pattern matches the output of the previous command.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file or directory does not exist.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for differences.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
